translation.name: Testament cub coʼ nac diʼs ndac cheʼn Tad Jesucrist

book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: Di's Co' Mblo Xo'f Jesucrist Loo Juàn Co' Mque' Juàn Ye's Loo Mèn

content: Thìb angl nzo thìb libr chu'th ya'.

Be taa be taa mxaquen mbyú' loo loon. Gunèen tedib angl. Loo angla mbli Diox ngòp angl huax con' la's nii angl no huax con' la's ya' angl. Angla nde làa loo bé' le'n xcuau. No mxaquen ne' angl thìb mbèel qui'th yéc angl. Rloo angl ante nquée xnìi xal co'se' nguin huiz. Le' nii angl na, gunaa xal bèel co' ndxetoo.
Gunèen nzo thìb libr chu'th ya' angl. Ndoo xal' loo libr. No gunèen ndoo sa nii angl co' nac ladlì loo níttó'. Le' taasa nii angl co' nac ladrebes na, ndoo loo yòo biiz.
Ngoloa, cabii ngrozèe angl xal co'se' mbez yèe yii mbez yèe den thìb mbee's. No co'se' ngrozèe angl, leque tiempa ngos mblya'b gundii gaz vez. Mbyèn bii gundiia axta plóthe.

Co'se' ngolo ngos mblya'b gundii gaz vez no mbyèn bii gundii axta plóthe, daa co' nac Juàn mblyazen ntlon, nque'en ye's cón che'n con' mbìnen. Per látha, mbìnen thìb di's co' mbyèn loo bé' co' gunee loon: ―Juàn, ante le'n lezo'l blosua' cón nee di's gundii co' ngos mblya'b gaz veza. No indlyasten que'l ye's cón che'na.
Ngoloa, chàa, gunèen angl co' mdoo nii loo níttó' no loo yòo biiz. Mde'f angl ya' angl co' nac ladlì loo bé'.

Mde'th angl lèe Diox, Diox co' nabanque' thidtene, Diox co' mblec no co' mxèn' bé' no izlyo' no níttó' no ryethe taamas con' co' mblec Diox no co' mxèn' Diox. Ndxab angl: ―Nase, por lèe Diox niin loo gu': Mzinle' hor co'se' li Diox con' co' mnibe' Diox loo lezo' Diox li Diox loo mèn. Ya ne'lyen'te Diox más.

Tac co'se' gal hor cuez angl co' nac gaz angl co' nde nque trompet angl, ya mdyaale' tiemp co' ngòcle' tiemp co'se' li Diox ryethe con' co' mnibe' Diox loo lezo' Diox li Diox loo mèn loo izlyo' ndxè' ndoore' lith no izlyo' ndxè' xalque' mblu' Diox loo mèn co' ngo ban póla, mèn co' mde'th di's co' ndxab Diox, mèn co' mxo'f zin' zin' che'n Diox. Con'a nac con' co' mbli Diox co' ngo casloo loo mèn le'n dib lal tiempa axta nalle'.

Di's co' mbìnen gunii loon loo bé', guniii loon tedib vez. Gunee di's loon: ―Juàn, huàa co'te' ndoo angl ba'. No fxen libr chu'th co' ndoo xal' co' nzo ya' angl, angl co' ndoo sa nii loo níttó' no co' ndoo taasa nii loo yòo biiz.

Sya, nguan co'te' ndoo angl. No mna'ben loo angl ta' angl libr chu'tha càan. Angl gunee loon: ―Aa libr ndxè'. Dhua libr. Co'se' ngue yuhual libr ndxè' ten'l nazi' nac libr xal mzin le'n ro'l. Per co'se' ngolo nduhual libr, ten'l nalà ngòc libr le'n lezo'l.

Sya, mxenen libr chu'th co' nzo ya' angla. No ale nduhuan libr. No, lìcque', mxaquen ale nazi' ngòc libr chu'tha xal mzin le'n ro'en co'se' ngue yuhuan libr. Per co'se' ngolo nduhuan libr, mden'en ngòc nalà libr le'n lezon.

Luega gunee angl loon: ―Lùu nquin bere tyoodi's no ta'l cuent xal ñibe' Diox lool loo mèn huax yèez, no loo mèn huax nación, no loo mèn co' ndyoodi's chol di'stèe, no loo mèn co' ñibe' loo chol nación, ndee.
